millimetreFrameBasis: Exact voxel-index equivalence to protocol-mapped fine labels with declared millimetre source grid; numeric sforms also exactly equal. This does not fill missing coarse header units or register different subjects.
scope: All present non-background categorical classes; research only, no clinical or runtime approval
sulcalMeaning: CSF territories assigned around labelled folds, not original traced sulcal centre-lines or independently validated gyral banks
meshMethod: Every exposed 0.5 mm cell face; all cavities and components; two outward triangles per square; no smoothing or repair
